Mounting Bracket Reference Notes

Original short reference notes authored for 3di-men's test suite.

A mounting bracket transfers load between two perpendicular or angled
faces, typically through a base plate and one or more upright arms. For
sheet-metal brackets, keep hole edge margin at least 1.5 times the hole
diameter to avoid tearing the material during manufacture.

Bolt circle patterns should use at least 3 bolts for rotational stability;
4 bolts in a square or rectangular pattern is the most common arrangement
for a mounting plate. The bolt circle diameter must be smaller than the
part's own outer dimensions with enough margin for the hole's own edge
distance, or the holes will break out of the part's edge.
